svg.title: From pull requests to a published release
svg.desc: Pull requests titled fix, feat or feat! are merged into main, and the release bot keeps the pull request chore: release x.y.z with the version and the changelog. Once the maintainer merges it, a draft release with its tag is created, the package is built and checked, signed with the app's certificate, and gets its signature, SBOM and provenance. Then the release is published and immutable, delivered to the Nextcloud App Store, and verified, and every week again.
